adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts, lines 63-99 show new code that fetches a refreshed token, parses it with parseRefreshTokenResponse, and saves it to the database via prisma.credential.update. However, the code after this (line 106 in the finding, which corresponds to the jsforce.Connection construction) still uses `credentialKey.access_token` - the original credential that was loaded at line 60 (`const credentialKey = credential.key as unknown as ExtendedTokenResponse`). The new refreshed token is stored in `accessTokenParsed.data` but is never used to update `credentialKey` before constructing the connection. This means the connection will be created with the old/expired access token instead of the newly refreshed one.
